method: For each official tagged source archive, map every regular file (excluding the one archived symlink docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) to SHA-256. A hop change is the sorted symmetric difference of path/hash maps. npm-package-inventory.json separately maps every regular npm package file and exact added/removed/changed/identical sets.
